Task acceptance not fulfilled: the review found that the candidate does not satisfy source issue #227. Change the candidate so it satisfies everything the issue requires; the reviewer's acceptance evidence:
- The archive adapter and GNU-flag capability test attribute the local planner failure to the production tar flags, but the named case now fails before it can serve as a passing regression.
- Both new final-read checks expect `w.head` at read 12; the fair scan starts at `r9` and ends at `r19`, so the deterministic regression does not pass.

[P1] Correct final fair-scan read expectation

With 20 work candidates, `9009 % 20` is 9, so after the base-tip read the scan visits `r9` first and then `r10` through `r19`. The 12th `checkRuns:latest` call is therefore for `records[19].target.head`, while `w.head` is only read second; this assertion and the identical one at line 706 fail on every platform. Remove them or assert the actual final read.
